title: The invoiced work order card shows the reps as plain text
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The browser window is 1440 px wide with the zoom at 100%, and the design picture "card-17-n1-invoiced.png" (board 1.17) attached to this case is open beside it at 100% (actual size). Names, numbers and dates in the pictures are sample data.
  • Two active staff members at {Location-A} have their "Sales Representative" switch on: {Sales-rep-A} and {Sales-rep-B}.
    For example: {Sales-rep-A} is ZZAUTOTEST Ann Able and {Sales-rep-B} is ZZAUTOTEST Ben Able.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has no sales representative.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST SSR Fleet.
  • Work order {Work-order-1} for {Customer-A} exists; Labor reads {Sales-rep-A} and Parts reads {Sales-rep-B}; it has been invoiced.
    For example: {Work-order-1} is S2-40001.
  • Starting screen: {Work-order-1} is open in that browser window.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps: 1. Hover over the representative rows and compare with the picture of board 1.17.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: "Sales Representative - Labor" {Sales-rep-A} and "Sales Representative - Parts" {Sales-rep-B} as plain text, with no box, arrow, + or remove x even on hover, as in the picture; Lead Technician and Service Advisor keep the labels an invoiced card shows today. Measured on the screen, every gap between Lead Technician, Service Advisor and both representative fields is 16 px.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11265 (Story 1, Give a work order its sales representative), story SV-11266 (Story 2, Give a work order a separate Labor and Parts representative)

  • S2-R17: “Once the work order is invoiced or paid, or when it is opened from its history, each field is plain text with the same label and wording, with no + or remove x. A work order with both fields shows both labels with their names. On the read-only card only the Sales Representative fields read as in S1-R2 and S2-R5; Lead Technician and Service Advisor keep today's read-only labels.”
  • S1-R6: “The vertical gap between Lead Technician, Service Advisor and every Sales Representative field on the card is 16px. This holds with one field, with the Labor and Parts fields (S2-R5), and on the read-only card (S2-R17).”

From: Chris Ward's answers to the Splitting Sales Representatives question sheet (answers 1 to 38, 19 Oct 2026; answers 39 and 40, 21 Oct 2026), read 22 Oct 2026

  • Chris Ward's answer 8: “8. (a) Lead technician and Service advisor stay as they are today; only the Sales Representative fields use the new labels.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

Claude design canvas "Splitting Sales Representatives" (https://claude.ai/artifact/8MHqwyffAYtqZ6EccS5RUm), export read 19 Oct 2026, boards 1.17 After invoicing: read only (the attached pictures are these boards).

  • Design — board 1.17 title: “1.17 After invoicing: read only”
  • Design — board 1.17 note: “Invoiced work order S2-17540 with two reps. The rows are plain text: "Sales Representative - Labor" Daniel Montoya, "Sales Representative - Parts" Becky Gonzales. Measured gaps: 16px, 16px, 16px (decision 47). Hovering the rows changes nothing: no box, no arrow, no + and no remove x (checked in the browser: zero buttons on the card; the hovered screenshot is identical to this one).”
